id.description: The name of the branch, such as "develop", "release", or "master"

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

lastCommit.description: The SHA of the last commit looked at by the automation.

timeOfLastCommit.description:
The timestamp of the last commit looked at. NOT the timestamp of the last run of the automation.
The next run of the automation will look at commits after this timestamp.

lastRun.description: Information about the last run of the automation.

title: Stored information about the last run of the Jira Ticket Closing Automation for the next run to use.
name: Tas.CloseAutomationState
